args.body: Advance SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT using the committed fees, prohibited-products and supported-countries captures and package-readback.json. Verify the actual policy wording and distinguish country support from completed onboarding. Within the existing source allowance, use the strongest directly linked first-party onboarding or payout page to resolve the remaining material prerequisite. Tie the result to the exact tested archive and document the redistribution authority for both members. If supported, finish one operator-ready private listing packet with the exact download, AI disclosure, tested scope, one provisional price in an explicitly supported currency, per-sale proceeds under the published fee cases, payout timing and the activation decision. Flag taxes, conversion, refund effects and costs where unverified. If a decisive condition remains unresolved, save the exact evidence needed to reopen it. Reuse any completed equivalent verdict. Read back the committed artifact and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sales, payout and Treasury settlement separate. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

description: Lemon Squeezy’s published fee, product policy and country pages returned HTTP 200, and the package inventory readback found two members and a recorded archive hash. That makes the existing SQLite lab the strongest near-term checkout test. Store activation, Canadian payout setup and redistribution authority still need evidence before a listing can proceed. An independent buyer-request search can continue in parallel. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded, with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
